pullRequest.title: feat: implement FR-12 local login gate (T-08)

implementationOverview: PRM-5 implements FR-12 (T_08): a local, client-side login gate before any contact data or controls are rendered. First-use setup creates a username and a salted SHA-256 hash of the passcode stored in a dedicated localStorage key (contact-management:auth:v1). Authentication is represented by a sessionStorage flag (tab-scoped) and cleared on logout. The contact manager UI is not mounted into the DOM until authenticated, and is unmounted on logout. Tests were added across unit//integration/browser layers to cover setup, login, logout, session behavior, and regression contact crud.
securityObservations: Credential storage uses a salted SHA-256 hash; plaintext passcode is not persisted.
The login gate is explicitly documented as a local convenience gate and not a security boundary.
UIs avoid interpolating user-provided values into innerHTML; new login disclosure text is set via textContent.
potentialRegressionAreas: Auth/contact UI mount-unmount lifecycle (logout, reload, rapid state changes).
Unsaved changes beforeunload warning install/cleanup when the contact UI is unmounted.
Test bypass path via seeded auth should not replace real login path coverage (auth.spec.ts does cover both).

findings.section: authState.subscribe catch block (contact mount failure fallback)
findings.description: On mount failure, the code sets currentView = "contact" to prevent duplicate attempts. This also prevents any future remount attempt without a page reload even if the user logouts/re-logins.
findings.whyItMatters: Recoverability: transient errors or partial state could leave the app stuck on an error screen.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Consider a separate "/error" view state or keep currentView as "/login"/"none" and allow a retry/relog mecajsnism to attempt mount again.

findings.description: Error fallback markup is set via innerHTML. It is constant today; ensure no user-controlled values are ever interpolated there.
findings.whyItMatters: Maintains a consistent XNS posture and prevents future regressions.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Keep the markup constant or build DOM nodes and set textContent for any variable text.

positive: First-use setup: creates credential, authenticates, contact UI.
Later visit: requires login, and success unlocks contact UI.
Same-tab reload: session persists via sessionStorage.
Logout: clears session flag, does not delete credential or contacts.
Regression: contact CRUD, search, recovery, unsaved changes warning.
negative: Wrong username or passcode: show exactly "invalid username or passcode" generic error.
Pre-login: contact data/controls are not present in DOM.
Crypto unavailable: setup/login transitions to "unavailable" state, user sees friendly message.
edge: Multi-tab: fresh tab requires login even with same localStorage credential.
Rapid logout/re-login cycles: no duplicate UI mounts or listeners.

notes: This review is based on static inspection via GitHub API. No local test execution was performed in Workflow 3.
